titulo.es: El presidente Daniel Ortega dice que “no volverá a haber elecciones” en Nicaragua
titulo.en: Daniel Ortega, President of Nicaragua, Says He Plans to Abolish Elections

sintesis.es: El presidente de Nicaragua, Daniel Ortega, en el poder desde hace casi dos décadas, suspende las elecciones en su país para evitar que la oposición llegue algún día al gobierno. Tras dos meses sin aparecer en público, Ortega, de 80 años, anunció esta prohibición en su discurso por el 47° aniversario de la revolución sandinista, celebrado en Managua.
sintesis.en: Daniel Ortega has been accused of rigging recent elections in Nicaragua. Now, the authoritarian leader says the nation won’t even hold a vote.

sintesis.es: La televisión iraní volvió a difundir imágenes de lo que, según afirmó, fueron ataques contra bases estadounidenses en Medio Oriente. Poco después sonaron las sirenas en Kuwait, donde el Ejército aseguró que sus sistemas de defensa interceptaron nuevos misiles iraníes. En Baréin también se reportaron ataques atribuidos a la República Islámica y, en paralelo, Jordania informó que interceptó y destruyó al menos cinco drones lanzados desde Irán.
sintesis.en: Meliá group says Donald Trump’s sanctions make it ‘impossible’ to keep any of its 34 sites open A Spanish hotel chain is to cease all operations in Cuba at the end of the week due to “major difficulties” in doing business on the island under growing pressure from Washington. titulo.es: Canada evaluating 'all options' after fresh US tariffs threat
titulo.en: Canada evaluating 'all options' after fresh US tariffs threat

sintesis.es: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Tuesday he was looking at "all options" after US President Donald Trump made plans to impose new 50 percent tariffs on many Canadian goods in 30 days. Carney also said that he and Trump had agreed to "intensify discussions" in the coming weeks on a possible deal, but did not suggest he would travel to Washington for any talks. FRANCE 24's Christopher Guly reports from Ottawa.

titulo.es: WHO adds first diagnostic test for Ebola Bundibugyo virus to its Emergency Use Listing
titulo.en: WHO adds first diagnostic test for Ebola Bundibugyo virus to its Emergency Use Listing

sintesis.es: Today, the World Health Organization (WHO) has added the first molecular diagnostic test for Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) to its Emergency Use Listing (EUL) . The test detects the virus by identifying its genetic material in blood samples, helping confirm infection rapidly and accurately. WHO’s EUL procedure assesses the quality, safety and performance of essential health products based on the available evidence, while ensuring they meet minimum international standards and address the needs of low- and middle-income countries.

titulo.es: España gana el Mundial 2026 ante Argentina y la FIFA investiga incidentes en la final
titulo.en: Spain wins 2026 World Cup against Argentina as FIFA investigates post-final incidents

sintesis.es: España se proclamó campeona del Mundial 2026 al derrotar 1-0 a Argentina en la prórroga, con gol de Ferran Torres, logrando su segunda estrella. El partido, disputado en el estadio MetLife de Nueva Jersey, terminó con incidentes en el campo que involucraron a jugadores y al cuerpo técnico argentino tras el pitazo final. La FIFA abrió una investigación disciplinaria que podría derivar en sanciones para la Asociación del Fútbol Argentino (AFA), mientras España celebraba masivamente su triunfo.
sintesis.en: Spain became 2026 World Cup champion after defeating Argentina 1-0 in extra time, with a goal from Ferran Torres, securing their second star. The match, held at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey, ended with on-field incidents involving Argentine players and coaching staff after the final whistle. FIFA opened a disciplinary investigation that could lead to sanctions against the Argentine Football Association (AFA), while Spain celebrated massively.

titulo.es: New dark matter theory could solve multiple cosmic mysteries at once
titulo.en: New dark matter theory could solve multiple cosmic mysteries at once

sintesis.es: Dark matter may be far more complicated than scientists once believed. A new study suggests it could consist of at least two different kinds of particles that slowly separate over time, with heavier particles sinking toward the centers of galaxies and lighter ones drifting outward. This simple idea could explain several puzzling cosmic observations that have frustrated astronomers for years, from unusually diffuse dwarf galaxies to surprisingly dense dark matter clumps that bend light through gravitational lensing.
